ai_summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited has announced the re-appointment of Mrs. Uma Manoj Mandavgane as a Non-Executive Independent Woman Director for a second five-year term, commencing May 31, 2027, following approval by shareholders via a Special Resolution. This re-appointment provides continuity of experienced independent oversight, leveraging her extensive background in risk advisory, corporate finance, and governance across various sectors. The disclosure indicates a routine corporate governance action, with no apparent red flags, conflicts of interest, or debarment issues.
